mapper.insert: INSERT INTO services (name, description, price, duration_minutes, active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{durationMinutes}, #{active}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE services SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, duration_minutes = #{durationMinutes}, active = #{active}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM services
AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND active = #{active}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM therapist_services ts WHERE ts.service_id = services.id AND ts.therapist_id = #{therapistId} )
ORDER BY
name price duration_minutes created_at id
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
